function: Learned hardware-impairment parameters tune the ISAC beamformer and a differentiable-OMP sensing receiver for multi-target detection and positioning, with a communication link served (p. 1, 6-9).
system: Monostatic OFDM ISAC with 64-antenna ULA, MISO link to a single-antenna user, 256 subcarriers, 60 GHz, up to 5 targets; no RIS (p. 3-4, 10).
method: Model-based end-to-end learning (deep-unfolding style): trainable steering-vector dictionary or impairment vector inside a differentiable OMP and LS beamformer; supervised GOSPA plus cross-entropy loss, Adam, offline (p. 6-10).
data_channel: Simulated only: radar-equation target echoes with Swerling-3 RCS and a LOS-plus-scatterer communication channel at 60 GHz; custom simulator, no 3GPP, DeepMIMO or measured data (p. 3-4, 10).
test_conditions: Trained over random angular sectors (mean within +-60 deg); tested at the [-40,-20] deg sector and at sector means up to 80 deg, beyond the training range (p. 10-13).
baselines: Non-learned: LS beamforming, OMP and ML detection with known or unknown impairments; greedy model-based calibration. Learned: only the paper's own dictionary-learning variant, no external learned baseline (p. 10-13).
metrics: Misdetection and false-alarm probability, position GOSPA loss and position error in meters, symbol error rate (p. 10-13).
complexity: Orders: added O((i_theta+1)(i_R+1)) per OMP iteration in training and O(|M|) for messages; learnable parameters K versus K*N_theta for dictionary learning; no FLOPs or runtime (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 3: "is given by the radar range equation [39, Eq. (2.8)]"; p. 10 adds Swerling-3 targets in a custom simulator. Missing: no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 12: "we include angular sectors that are not included in the training data described in Sec. V-A"; Fig. 9 tests sector means above 60 deg without retraining.
q3_support: p. 10: "we do not compare the proposed approaches with DL-based approaches"; Sec. V compares only the LS-OMP baseline, a calibration method and the paper's own dictionary learning (p. 11). Missing: an earlier learned method.
q4_support: p. 9: "the added complexity of the proposed MB-ML approaches"; gives O((i_theta+1)(i_R+1)) per OMP iteration and K versus K*N_theta learnable parameters.
q5_support: p. 10: "Source code to reproduce all numerical results in this paper is available at https://github.com/josemateosramos/MBE2EMTISAC"
notes: Area 5: the learned impairment parameters drive both the ISAC beamformer (sensing and communication precoders) and the OMP sensing receiver, with an ISAC trade-off in Fig. 8 (p. 12); the sensing task is multi-target positioning but the system also communicates (SER). Borderline: the learned parameters model array impairments, calibration-like, but they feed the ISAC beamformer and both receivers, so the work is kept as ISAC. q3 is 0: the only learned comparison is the paper's own dictionary learning, a variant of its framework that is as in the authors' earlier work [34] extended (p. 6), and footnote 8 (p. 10) says earlier DL approaches are not compared. A reviewer who counts [34] as the learned baseline would change q3.
